question: A sphere having a radius R is melted and recast into a hemisphere and a cylinder. The hemisphere and cylinder have equal radii and heights. If the height of the cylinder is equal to its radius r, find the ratio R:r.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume conserved: Sphere = Hemisphere + Cylinder

Sphere = 4/3 πR³

Hemisphere = 2/3 πr³, Cylinder = πr³ (since h = r)

Total = 2/3 πr³ + πr³ = 5/3 πr³

4/3 πR³ = 5/3 πr³ ⇒ R³ = 5/4 r³

**∴ Answer = R : r = ∛5 : ∛4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of sphere = R

Hemisphere and cylinder have radius = r

Height of cylinder = r

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = 4/3 πR³

Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 πr³

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

 Sphere (R) 
 
• Hemisphere (r) Cylinder (r, h=r) 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4/3 πR³

⇒ Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 πr³

⇒ Volume of cylinder = πr² × r = πr³

⇒ Total new volume = 2/3 πr³ + πr³ = 5/3 πr³

⇒ 4/3 πR³ = 5/3 πr³

⇒ R³ = 5/4 r³

⇒ R : r = ∛5 : ∛4

**∴ The correct answer is ∛5 : ∛4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Conservation Principle

When a solid is melted and recast, total volume remains constant

Sphere Volume

Volume = 4/3 πr³

Cylinder Volume

Volume = πr²h

Hemisphere Volume

Volume = 2/3 πr³
